The lenticular cloud that appeared in the sky over Bursa and resembled a UFO was seen from the Osmangazi, Nilüfer, Kestel, Gürsu, and Yıldırım districts. Many people recorded the cloud, which remained intact for a while, with their mobile phones. According to the General Directorate of Meteorology, lenticular clouds form as a result of wind fluctuations caused by irregularities in the terrain and can occur in every region where föhn winds are seen.

A lenticular cloud was seen in the skies of Bursa.

The cloud, visible from the districts of Osmangazi, Nilüfer, Kestel, Gürsu and Yıldırım and remaining intact for a while, attracted the attention of those who saw it.

Many people recorded this natural phenomenon in the sky with their mobile phones.

HOW DOES A LENTICULAR CLOUD FORM?

According to information obtained from the website of the General Directorate of Meteorology, lenticular clouds form as a result of wind fluctuations caused by terrain irregularities and indicate downward-moving turbulence on the sheltered side of the irregularity.

The cloud, which is the result of an orographic event and resembles a UFO, can be seen in any geographical area where foehn winds occur.
